build_commands.cpp: clang++ -O3 -flto -std=c++20 -pthread benchmarks/hosted/cpp/suite.cpp benchmarks/hosted/cpp/algorithms.cpp benchmarks/hosted/cpp/data_structures.cpp benchmarks/hosted/cpp/compute.cpp benchmarks/hosted/cpp/memory.cpp benchmarks/hosted/cpp/io.cpp benchmarks/hosted/cpp/adversarial.cpp benchmarks/hosted/cpp/graph_churn.cpp -o benchmarks/build/hosted/cpp-suite
build_commands.rust: rustc -C opt-level=3 -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 --edition=2021 benchmarks/hosted/rust/suite.rs -o benchmarks/build/hosted/rust-suite

noise_model.spread: interquartile range over the median, larger of the two arms
noise_model.rule: win/loss needs the ratio of medians and the ratio of best runs both outside max(parity, spread, floor/median); otherwise parity

freestanding.metric_note: Guest instructions executed, from QEMU `-icount shift=0` read through the generic timer (1 tick = 16 instructions). Exact and repeatable; not a time, and it models no cache or pipeline.
freestanding.verdict_rule: absolute: fewer instructions is a win, more a loss, an equal count level

rust: rustc --edition=2021 --crate-type=staticlib --target aarch64-unknown-none-softfloat --sysroot benchmarks/build/freestanding/rust-sysroot -C opt-level=3 -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C panic=abort -C relocation-model=static -C target-cpu=generic -o benchmarks/build/freestanding/rust-suite.a benchmarks/freestanding/rust/lib.rs
